description: Find businesses listed on BOP in Taiwan (personal trainers and coaches, gyms, group-class studios, saunas, recovery services) by keyword and/or category, with a few of their services and prices. Use this when the user wants to find a coach, gym, class or studio in Taiwan, or wants to book or check times but has not named a business, e.g. 「幫我找台北的健身教練」 or 「週日想上重訓課」. keyword takes place and class words in Chinese or English (business name, city or district, type of class); booking and time words such as 訂、預約、週日 are ignored, so check times with get_availability. Returns up to 10 businesses. If nothing matches the keyword, it returns the listed businesses anyway with matched: false. Read-only.

category.description: gym, coaching (personal trainers), sauna, or recovery

keyword.description: Place or class words in Chinese or English, e.g. '健身教練 台北', '重訓', 'personal training' or 'Taipei'

name: search_businesses
title: Search businesses
